name: The Last Ninja & IK Collection
summary:
The Last Ninja & IK Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together two of System 3's most celebrated series across their original home computer platforms (ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, Atari ST):

- The Last Ninja — Take command of Armakuni the last ninja, seeking to avenge the assassination of his clan, in the original 8-bit release.
- Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance — Armakuni's action-adventure continues in modern-day New York.
- Last Ninja 3 — The trilogy's conclusion, as Armakuni chases the evil Kunitoki through time to a final confrontation.
- Ninja Remix — A remixed version reimagining the first Last Ninja game with new gameplay.
- International Karate — The original one-on-one martial arts fighting classic.
- IK+ — The sequel adding a third combatant for free-for-all three-way karate battles.

Each title is included across its original ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari ST versions.
